entities.summary: Julie Zhuo is a Chinese-American businesswoman and computer scientist whose work has significantly impacted the field of product design at Facebook. Born and raised in the United States to Chinese parents, Zhuo's early life and education at Stanford University laid the foundation for her future success. She joined Facebook in 2013 and quickly rose through the ranks, becoming the company's vice president of product design in 2017. During her tenure, Zhuo was instrumental in shaping the company's product roadmap and overseeing the development of several successful products, including Facebook's mobile app. In 2019, Zhuo left Facebook to co-found Sundial, a new venture that aims to make software development more accessible and equitable. Zhuo's contributions to the tech industry have been recognized through numerous awards and speaking engagements, cementing her status as a leading voice in the field of product design. As the author of 'The Making of a Manager,' Zhuo has also shared her insights on leadership and management, making her a sought-after expert in the business world. Today, Zhuo continues to inspire and influence the next generation of product designers, ensuring her legacy as a trailblazer in the industry.
